step1_analysis.description: A resistorless bandgap reference core that utilizes diode-connected and linear-region MOS transistors to generate a temperature-independent reference voltage, avoiding the large area of passive resistors.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Bandgap Reference Without Resistors

v_ref.description: Output reference voltage at room temperature.

sky130_expected.calculation: VOUT is determined by the intersection of the load lines of XM1 (diode-connected PMOS) and XM5 (NMOS current sink). With N1=N3=VDD, VD2 settles to ~0.7V. Since XM1/XM5 match XM4/XM7, VOUT mirrors VD2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and Vth (~0.42V). The original paper used a 3.7V supply, allowing for a higher reference voltage.

power.description: Total power consumption of the reference circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Sum of currents in all branches. XM3 draws ~475uA, XM4/7 ~100uA, XM2 ~115uA, XM1/5 ~100uA. Total current ~790uA. Power = 1.8V * 790uA = 1.42mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported 1.4mW closely, assuming N1 and N3 are tied to VDD.

temp_variation.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage change over the temperature range (0 C to 70 C).

sky130_expected.calculation: The circuit balances PTAT and CTAT currents to minimize temperature drift. Expected to be in the mV range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be similar to the paper's 9.4mV, though exact cancellation depends heavily on precise W/L trimming which is not present in the parameterized netlist.

psrr.description: Power Supply Rejection Ratio at 100 Hz.

sky130_expected.calculation: AC gain from VDD to VOUT at 100Hz. Without a high-gain op-amp, PSRR is moderate, determined by channel length modulation (lambda=0.1).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard metric for bandgap references. A simple resistorless topology typically achieves -20 to -40 dB PSRR without additional regulation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC reference voltage, power consumption, temperature variation (0-70C), and PSRR.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMOS Bandgap Reference Without Resistors Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

XM1 VOUT VOUT N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM7 VD2 VD2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM2 GND VD2 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM4 VD2 VD2 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM3 GND GND N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM5 VOUT VD2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

* Power supply with AC component for PSRR measurement
VVDD VDD 0 1.8 ac 1

* Connect N1 and N3 to VDD (acting as supply rails for the sub-circuit)
R1 VDD N1 0.001
R2 VDD N3 0.001

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point (v_ref and power)
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  let v_ref = v(VOUT)
  print v_ref
  print power

  * 2. Temperature Sweep (0 C to 70 C)
  dc temp 0 70 1
  meas dc vout_max max v(VOUT)
  meas dc vout_min min v(VOUT)
  let temp_variation = vout_max - vout_min
  print temp_variation

  * 3. AC Analysis (PSRR)
  ac dec 10 1 1G
  let psrr_db = vdb(VOUT)
  meas ac psrr_100Hz find psrr_db at=100
  
  quit
.endc
.end
